one_line: Early Mysore chief under the Vijayanagara world, later remembered as the founding ancestor of the Wodeyar dynasty.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, about average height with a practiced warrior’s posture
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Mysore complexion, neatly trimmed short moustache, calm yet alert almond-shaped eyes; default expression is composed and dignified, with a hint of cautious determination befitting a small but ambitious local lord
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted at the center, drawn back into a modest low knot at the back of the head and mostly hidden under a deep-red cloth turban (Vijayanagara-style pugree) with a narrow golden border and a small, simple leaf-shaped metal ornament at the front
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length white cotton angarakha-style tunic wrapping left-over-right, tied with internal ties and a narrow off-white sash; over this a sleeveless, slightly quilted dark-indigo cotton kavacha-style vest for light protection, edged with muted gold piping; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped off-white dhoti-style vastra, pleated in front and reaching the ankles, with a thin red border, worn over simple brown leather sandals; around his waist a practical dark-brown leather belt holds a small cloth pouch; a plain, mid-length off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) with a subtle narrow red stripe along the edge is draped from his left shoulder across the torso and tucked at the belt, suggesting both respectability and readiness to move; jewellery is restrained— a thin gold chain around the neck, a single simple gold ring on his right hand, and small, plain gold stud earrings, reflecting a minor feudatory’s status rather than a great king.
appearance.signature: A medium-length, gently curved southern talwar-like sword with a simple steel blade, an unadorned iron hilt with a small knuckle-guard, and a brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, worn slung at his left hip from his belt.

ref_desc: Yaduraya Wodeyar is a mid-30s lean brown-complexioned man with an oval face, neat moustache, black hair in a low knot under a deep-red bordered turban, wearing a white angarakha, dark-indigo sleeveless vest, off-white dhoti, off-white shawl, minimal gold jewellery, and a simple talwar at his left hip in a brown scabbard, in a palette of white, off-white, deep red, dark indigo, and brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Yaduraya Wodeyar: a mid-30s, lean, medium-brown Mysore man with an oval face, straight nose, neatly trimmed short moustache, and composed, dignified expression, his thick black hair parted at the center and tied in a low knot mostly hidden beneath a deep-red cloth turban with a narrow golden border and a small leaf-shaped metal ornament at the front; dress him in a knee-length white cotton angarakha-style tunic wrapping left-over-right, a sleeveless slightly quilted dark-indigo cotton vest edged with muted gold piping over it, and a tightly wrapped off-white dhoti reaching the ankles with a thin red border, worn with simple brown leather sandals; drape an off-white cotton shawl with a subtle narrow red stripe from his left shoulder across the torso and tucked into a dark-brown leather belt that also supports a small cloth pouch; add restrained jewellery only—a thin gold chain at the neck, small gold stud earrings, and a single plain gold ring on his right hand—emphasising him as a modest Vijayanagara-era local lord; at his left hip hang his signature weapon, a medium-length gently curved talwar-like sword with a plain steel blade, unadorned iron hilt with a small knuckle-guard, and a brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings; keep the colour palette focused on white, off-white, deep red, dark indigo and brown, and show him in neutral poses that clearly display his face, hairstyle, turban, garments, belt, sandals, and sword for consistent redrawing.
